findings.current: A miracle that had finally united the people of thirty-two tribes.
findings.defect: This drops the source’s explicit image of the tribespeople having been divided into thirty-two groups before they were brought together.
findings.rationale: The Korean says the miracle made the tribespeople, who had been divided into thirty-two groups, unite in one accord. The accepted baseline preserved that division; the assembled copy retains the number but loses the division.
findings.replacement: A miracle that had finally brought together the tribespeople divided among thirty-two tribes.

summary: The chapter is faithful overall. The assembled copy omits the explicit division of Nanman’s tribes in the concluding unity statement.
